C2CRM Features
 
 
 
 
 
Explore what features and benefits C2CRM has to offer.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Increase Sales
 
 
Sales teams manage your pipeline from lead management to closed sales. Automate sales processes with your customer data. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Customer Satisfaction
 
 
Provide a better customer experience with centralized help desk ticketing, knowledgebase, and project management.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Data Integration
 
 
Gain a 360-degree view of your customers by integrating C2CRM with outside applications like ERP and Accounting systems.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Analytics & Intelligence
 
 
Easily analyze your team members’ activities and marketing campaigns with C2CRM’s custom dashboards, reports, and graphs. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Marketing Automation
 
 
Keep your business in front of customers and qualified prospects with email marketing, drip campaigns, and lead scoring.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Increase Productivity
 
 
C2CRM’s mobile app increases productivity while out of the office. Access your CRM data with our apps available for iOS and Android.

How is C2CRM Different?
 
 
 
 
 
Clear C2 has developed our CRM solution over the past 25 years. We use your business process to transform your business into a customer-focused organization. C2CRM is poised to react quickly in today’s fast-paced marketplace.
 
Our CRM platform is simple to use and easy to implement. Whether your company is a small business or a large enterprise, you will love our CRM system and our employees.

Privacy Overview
 
 
This website uses cookies so that we can provide you with the best user experience possible. Cookie information is stored in your browser and performs functions such as recognising you when you return to our website and helping our team to understand which sections of the website you find most interesting and useful.
 
 
 
 
 
Strictly Necessary Cookies
 
 
Strictly necessary cookies are required for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. These cookies are usually set in response to actions you take, such as setting privacy preferences, logging in, or submitting forms.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Enable or Disable Cookies

Disabled
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Analytics Cookies
 
 
Analytics cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our website, which pages are visited, and how we can improve the site. These cookies are only used if you consent.

Cookie Policy
 
 
Clear C2, Inc.
Last Updated:
 Jun 24, 2026
This Cookie Policy explains how Clear C2, Inc. (“Clear C2,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) uses cookies and similar technologies on our website and related online services.
This Cookie Policy should be read together with our Privacy Policy. Our Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect personal information more generally.
1. What Are Cookies?
Cookies are small text files that are placed on your browser, computer, or mobile device when you visit a website. Cookies allow websites to recognize a browser or device, remember preferences, support website functionality, improve performance, and understand how visitors interact with the site.
We may also use similar technologies, including pixels, tags, scripts, web beacons, local storage, embedded content, software development kits, and other tracking or storage technologies. For simplicity, this Cookie Policy refers to cookies and similar technologies collectively as “cookies.”
2. Why We Use Cookies
We use cookies and similar technologies to:
Operate and secure our website
Remember cookie and privacy preferences
Enable form submissions and website functionality
Support customer login and portal functionality
Understand how visitors use our website
Improve website performance and content
Measure the effectiveness of marketing or outreach campaigns
Provide or control access to embedded content, scheduling tools, videos, maps, or similar functionality
Detect, prevent, and respond to fraud, abuse, security incidents, or technical issues
Some cookies are strictly necessary for our website to function. Other cookies are optional and will only be used where permitted by law and, where required, after you provide consent.
3. Types of Cookies We Use
We organize cookies into the following categories.
A. Strictly Necessary Cookies
Strictly necessary cookies are required for the website to function and cannot be switched off through our cookie preference center.
These cookies may be used to:
Load website pages
Maintain website security
Remember your cookie preferences
Enable form submissions
Support account login or customer portal access
Prevent fraud, abuse, or unauthorized access
Maintain basic website functionality
Because these cookies are necessary to provide the website or service you request, they do not require consent where applicable law allows them to be used without consent.
Examples may include:
Cookie or Technology
Purpose
Duration
Cookie consent preference cookie
Remembers your cookie choices
365 Days
WordPress or website session cookies
Supports site functionality, login, or session management
48 Hours
Security or fraud-prevention cookies
Helps protect the site from abuse or unauthorized access
2-14 Days
Form security cookies or tokens
Helps process and secure form submissions
48 Hours
B. Analytics Cookies
Analytics cookies help us understand how visitors use our website. They may collect information such as pages visited, time spent on pages, referring pages, browser type, device type, general location derived from IP address, and website interactions.
We use analytics information to:
Understand website traffic
Improve website content
Identify technical issues
Measure page performance
Improve user experience
Analytics cookies are optional and will only be used where permitted by law and, where required, after you provide consent.
Examples may include:

Purpose

Google Analytics cookies, if used

C. Marketing and Advertising Cookies
Marketing and advertising cookies may be used to understand campaign performance, measure advertising effectiveness, support remarketing, personalize outreach, or help us understand how visitors interact with Clear C2 marketing content.
Marketing and advertising cookies may collect information about your browser, device, website interactions, referral source, and online identifiers. Depending on the tool, third-party advertising or social media platforms may also receive information when these technologies are enabled.
Marketing and advertising cookies are optional and will only be used where permitted by law and, where required, after you provide consent.
Examples may include:
 
Cookie or Technology

Purpose

Google Ads or remarketing tags, if used

D. Functional and Embedded Content Cookies
Functional and embedded content cookies support optional website features or third-party content. These may include videos, maps, scheduling tools, chat widgets, forms, calendars, or other embedded services.
These tools may transmit information to third parties when they are loaded. For that reason, where required by law, we do not load non-essential embedded content until you provide consent.
Examples may include:
Cookie or Technology
Provider
Purpose
Duration
Scheduling or demo calendar tools, if used

90 Days

14 Days

If you do not consent to functional or embedded content cookies, some features may not load or may display a placeholder asking you to update your cookie preferences.
4. First-Party and Third-Party Cookies
Cookies may be either first-party cookies or third-party cookies.
First-party cookies
 are set by Clear C2 or by our website.
Third-party cookies
 are set by service providers or third-party platforms whose tools are used on our website, such as analytics providers, advertising platforms, embedded content providers, scheduling tools, or security providers.
Third-party providers may process information according to their own privacy policies. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party services you choose to interact with.
5. Cookies and Personal Information
Some cookies may collect or be associated with information that identifies, relates to, describes, or could reasonably be linked to a browser, device, or individual.
This may include:
IP address
Browser type
Device type
Operating system
Referring URL
Pages viewed
Date and time of visit
General location derived from IP address
Cookie identifiers
Website interactions
Form interaction data
Campaign or referral information
For more information about how we collect, use, disclose, and protect personal information, please review our Privacy Policy.
6. How We Obtain Consent
When you visit our website, we may present a cookie banner or cookie preference center.
Depending on your location and applicable law, you may be able to:
Accept all cookies
Reject non-essential cookies
Manage cookie categories
Save specific cookie preferences
Change or withdraw consent later
We do not intentionally load non-essential analytics, marketing, advertising, or embedded third-party technologies before consent where consent is required by law.
Strictly necessary cookies may remain active because they are required for the website to function.
